info.title: VitalServer Runtime Platform Control API
info.description: Public control-plane API v1. Every read returns an owner-supplied ReadResult. Commands return a durable Operation, a CommandRejection when they were not admitted, or a typed admission/forwarding failure when existence cannot safely be inferred; they do not synthesize state from another owner.

502.description: The Host facade attempted command forwarding but cannot state whether the Guest command exists

post.summary: Stream one complete user-uploaded .vital file into the Lab replay source owner
post.description: The bounded base64url JSON command in X-Vital-Lab-Replay-Source-Command declares byteSize and sha256. The application/x-vital body remains one immutable source object and is not reclassified as a Recorder upload or Gateway cold-path artifact.

400.description: The command header was malformed or invalid

415.description: The body media type is not application/x-vital

422.description: The streamed bytes do not match the declared size and digest

503.description: The owner outcome is unavailable or unknown

get.summary: Read the immutable raw packet sequence for a finalized Recorder Gateway capture
get.description: Guest-loopback-only. A binary success response is raw source evidence, not a .vital artifact, upload receipt, or indexing claim. A non-available owner read is returned as an explicit JSON ReadResult.

200.description: A receipt-finalized raw packet sequence, or an explicit non-available read result

403.description: The caller is outside the Guest-loopback control boundary

post.summary: Finalize a Recorder Gateway cold-path capture into raw packet-sequence evidence
post.description: Guest-loopback-only. A successful response attests only to raw packet-sequence source evidence; it does not attest to .vital formation, artifact upload, or upstream indexing.

201.description: The capture was finalized, or the exact requestId was replayed idempotently

400.description: The command was rejected before cold-path finalization was admitted

403.description: The caller is outside the Guest-loopback control boundary

503.description: Recorder Gateway could not determine whether finalization was durably admitted; retry the exact requestId after recovery
